set.body:
Source: review finding in SlurmCommands.scala and SacctParsable2.

Problem:
the command requests JobIDRaw while the parser resolves array identity from JobID-style <arrayJobId>_<index> values. Missing --array can group elements, and one bracket or malformed row currently fails the entire batch.

Acceptance:
- Request accounting fields/options that preserve per-element identity, including --array and JobID where supported.
- Map terminal OOM/TIMEOUT/etc. to the requested array element without aliasing siblings.
- Isolate unrelated, bracket-summary, and malformed rows so valid requested rows survive with explicit missing/diagnostic evidence.
- Add a provenance-stamped real sacct fixture plus parser tests for elements, steps, pending summaries, unknown values, and mixed-good/bad batches.
set.title: P6f.5: Correct sacct array accounting and row isolation
